compiled_state.title: Add contract-reference grep check to skill-refs harness
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD1 (verification): ensures references from reviewer-base.md and review-fix-dispatch.md to both contracts remain present and don't degrade silently

## What
Extend `.claude/scripts/dso check-skill-refs.sh` (or equivalent harness) to verify that both new contract files are referenced from reviewer-base.md and review-fix-dispatch.md.

If check-skill-refs.sh is not extensible, add a dedicated grep check to an appropriate test file in tests/ that:
1. Verifies `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md` contains references to `review-findings-schema.md` AND `review-defenses.md`
2. Verifies `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md` contains references to `review-findings-schema.md` AND `review-defenses.md`

This prevents silent contract drift (contracts updated, prompts forget).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Verification check exists and passes
  Verify: grep -q "review-findings-schema.md" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md && grep -q "review-defenses.md" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md && grep -q "review-findings-schema.md" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md && grep -q "review-defenses.md" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
